# Epilepsy Surgery

**Authors:** Sunil Munakomi, Joe M. Das

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Epilepsy surgery is indicated in 30% to 40% of patients with refractory seizure disorders despite being on one year of therapy with an adequate dosage of two antiepileptic therapy. Though the anterior temporal lobectomy has been the prototype epilepsy surgery, there has been a paradigm shift in the surgical principle of ensuring maximum disconnection of the epileptic neural pathways, in sharp contrast to the previous concepts of governing maximal surgical resection.
